from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8df5b216.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            components.append(comp)
    template = max(components, key=len)
    template_set = set(template)
    other = [(r,c) for comp in components if comp is not template for r,c in comp]
    minr = min(r for r,c in template); maxr = max(r for r,c in template)
    minc = min(c for r,c in template); maxc = max(c for r,c in template)
    cr, cc = (minr + maxr)//2, (minc + maxc)//2
    offsets = [(r-cr, c-cc, grid[r][c]) for r,c in template]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ar, ac in other:
        for dr, dc, color in offsets:
            r, c = ar+dr, ac+dc
            if 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
ns={}; exec(source,ns)
ans=ns['transform'](grid)
